name: cup
title: Paper cup (traditional)
purpose: A drinking cup: the top must open into a pocket you could pour water into, so it can hold liquid.
notes: No magic numbers: the bisector of the left corner's angle meets the right edge at the pivot point, sqrt(2)-1 below the top. Folding the right corner onto the left edge with the crease through that pivot makes the flap's top edge level.

steps.description: Turn the square so it sits like a diamond.
Fold the bottom corner up to the top corner to make a triangle.
Fold the right corner over to the left edge so the flap's top edge is level.
Fold the left corner over to the right side, to the tip of the first flap.
Fold the front top flap down (front layer only).
Fold the other top flap down. Open the top: done!
